description: This file contains automated test procedures for validating UCI configuration cycles related to wireless and network settings on a device. It includes commands for setting, verifying, and toggling configuration options via UCI, along with comments explaining each step.
calls: R "uci set wireless.@wifi-iface[0].isolation='0'; uci commit wireless; /etc/init.d/network reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo done"
R "uci show wireless | grep -E 'isolation=' | sed 's/@[0-9]\+/@N/g' | sort | uniq"
R "uci -q set network.globals='globals' || true; uci set network.globals.ula_prefix='fd00:dead:beef::/48' || true; uci commit network; /etc/init.d/network reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo ok"
